jobs.title: AWS Python Data Engineer
jobs.description: Overview The Infosys Financial Services unit is a global leader in driving digital transformation for financial institutions. We specialize in leveraging advanced technologies such as AI, cloud, and data-led innovation to help our clients accelerate growth and unlock business value. Our AI-driven solutions empower financial institutions to make smarter decisions, enhance customer experiences, and achieve operational excellence. Join us to be part of a pioneering team that is at the forefront of financial services transformation. You'll have the opportunity to work with cutting-edge AI technologies, collaborate with industry experts, and contribute to transformative projects across banking, wealth management, and insurance sectors. If you're passionate about AI and eager to make a significant impact, the Infosys Financial Services unit is the perfect place for you to grow and excel. In the assigned Job Role of Technology Consultant 2, your Area Of Responsibility will be as below: Contribute to the requirements elicitation process by documenting assigned parts of business requirements, in line with guidance provided Facilitate software application design discussions, and document design decisions to guide the technical team towards building software solutions Participate in coding and integrate new features or updates into existing applications, with a focus on maintaining system stability Conduct code reviews, do changes to the codebase and maintain code repositories Implement test strategies, analyse results, and coordinate bug fixes to uphold the software quality standards Develop user training programs, documentation, and support frameworks to ensure a smooth transition to new software applications Actively participate in resolving production issues and recommend preventive strategies to enhance system reliability Maintain detailed records of code, testing techniques, and support activities to enrich the knowledge base and assist other similar projects Your Contribution To The Team A collaborative spirit and excellent communication skills. The ability to handle end to end SDLC phases from requirement gathering to implementation. A knack for translating complex requirements into actionable development tasks. A passion for design and hands-on coding experience A proactive approach to testing, troubleshooting, and refining our applications. The ability to work with cross-functional teams and do software integration. Required Skill And Experience Experience with AWS (EC2, ECS, ECR, EFS, EMR, Lambda, Step functions, RDS, Glue, S3, API Gateway), SQS/SNS, REST APIs & Microservices. Experience in Python libraries and scripting Experience with CI/CD (GitLab, Git), Docker & Kubernetes, Terraform (IaC), SDLC. Familiarities with Cloud-native architecture patterns, Production monitoring & reliability improvements Experience with System Design & Scalability. Preferred Skill And Experience Experience with Pyspark Experience with Fast API/Flask frameworks, Large-scale data processing (JSON/XML/Parquet) is preferred Experience with Distributed Systems, SQL & NoSQL (PostgreSQL, DynamoDB) Additional Required Qualifications Bachelor’s degree or foreign equivalent required from an accredited institution. Will also consider three years of progressive experience in the specialty in lieu of every year of education. This position may require relocation and/or travel to work/project location. Candidates authorized to work for any employer in the United States without employer-based visa sponsorship are welcome to apply. Infosys is unable to provide immigration sponsorship for this role now or in the future. Benefits Along with competitive pay, as a full-time Infosys employee you are also eligible for the following benefits: Medical/Dental/Vision/Life Insurance Long-term/Short-term Disability Health and Dependent Care Reimbursement Accounts Insurance (Accident, Critical Illness , Hospital Indemnity, Legal) 401(k) plan and contributions dependent on salary level Paid holidays plus Paid Time Off About Us Infosys is a global leader in next-generation digital services and consulting. We enable clients in more than 50 countries to navigate their digital transformation. With over four decades of experience in managing the systems and workings of global enterprises, we expertly steer our clients through their digital journey. We do it by enabling the enterprise with an AI-powered core that helps prioritize the execution of change. We also empower the business with agile digital at scale to deliver unprecedented levels of performance and customer delight. Our always-on learning agenda drives their continuous improvement through building and transferring digital skills, expertise, and ideas from our innovation ecosystem. EEO Infosys provides equal employment opportunities to applicants and employees without regard to race; color; sex; gender identity; sexual orientation; religious practices and observances; national origin; pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions; status as a protected veteran or spouse/family member of a protected veteran; or disability.

jobs.title: Power BI Developer
jobs.description: Business Intelligence Developer | Microsoft Fabric | Power BI | Frisco, TX 📍 Onsite 💰 Up to $130,000 I'm working with a growing professional services organization that's investing heavily in its modern data platform and is looking to hire a Business Intelligence Developer. This is a brand-new, greenfield position where you'll own the front end of the Microsoft BI stack, partnering closely with a Data Engineer to transform curated data into meaningful insights that drive business decisions. If you enjoy speaking with stakeholders, gathering requirements, designing intuitive dashboards, and building semantic models that people actually use, this is an opportunity to make a real impact. What you'll be doing: ✔ Build and optimize Power BI reports, dashboards, and semantic models ✔ Partner with business stakeholders to understand reporting requirements ✔ Work alongside the Data Engineering team within Microsoft Fabric ✔ Develop AI-enabled reporting experiences using Copilot Studio and Microsoft Fabric capabilities ✔ Improve reporting performance, governance, and self-service analytics across the business What they're looking for: ✔ 3-5 years of Power BI development experience ✔ Strong DAX, Power Query, M and data modelling skills ✔ Experience working with business stakeholders and gathering requirements ✔ PL-300 Certification ✔ Excellent communication skills Bonus points for: • Microsoft Fabric • Copilot Studio / AI Agents • Power Automate • SQL and data warehouse concepts • Microsoft Purview This is an ideal opportunity for someone who enjoys the business-facing side of BI just as much as the technical side, helping shape a modern analytics platform from the ground up. Interested? Apply today or reach out for a confidential conversation.

jobs.title: Splunk Reporting & Monitoring Analyst
jobs.description: We are seeking a highly skilled Splunk Reporting Monitoring Analyst to design, build, and maintain advanced Splunk dashboards, reports, and alerts that enable proactive and reactive operational support for enterprise collaboration and productivity platforms. This role directly supports Operations and Support teams within a financial services environment, ensuring high availability, performance, and user experience across critical business tools. The ideal candidate combines deep Splunk expertise, strong understanding of Microsoft 365 and Graph APIs, and a production operations mindset, with the ability to translate technical data into actionable insights for both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Key Responsibilities Splunk Reporting Dashboard Development Design, develop, and maintain custom Splunk dashboards, reports, and visualizations aligned with operational and business needs. Build optimized SPL queries to analyze large-scale log, event, and metric data. Customize dashboards for multiple audiences, including Operations, Support, Engineering, and Leadership. Ensure reports are accurate, scalable, performant, and easy to interpret. Monitoring, Alerting Proactive Operations Develop real-time and near-real-time alerts to detect service degradation, outages, and abnormal behavior. Partner with Operations and Support teams to define meaningful KPIs, SLIs, and thresholds. Enable proactive issue identification and trend analysis to reduce incidents and improve service reliability. Support reactive troubleshooting by providing deep-dive data and historical insights during incidents. Microsoft 365 Graph API Integration Leverage Microsoft Graph APIs to ingest, correlate, and analyze M365 telemetry and service signals. Create reporting solutions for collaboration and productivity tools (e.g., messaging, email, identity, usage, and performance). Correlate M365 data with infrastructure, application, and network telemetry in Splunk. Financial Institution Compliance Awareness Operate within a regulated financial services environment, ensuring reporting aligns with security, risk, and compliance requirements. Apply data governance, access control, and audit principles to Splunk content. Maintain awareness of operational risk, change management, and incident management processes. Stakeholder Collaboration Communication Act as a trusted partner to Operations, Support, Engineering, and Product teams. Translate complex technical data into clear narratives, summaries, and recommendations. Create executive-ready presentations and operational readouts. Document dashboards, reports, alert logic, and data sources clearly and consistently. Core Technical Expertise Advanced experience with Splunk Enterprise (search, dashboards, reports, alerts). Strong proficiency in SPL (Search Processing Language), including optimization techniques. Experience integrating external data sources and APIs into Splunk. Hands-on knowledge of Microsoft 365 services and Microsoft Graph APIs. Experience supporting Operations and Support monitoring for enterprise applications. Strong Analytical skills that translate into an Excel skillset Power BI Monitoring Operations Strong understanding of incident management, problem management, and service monitoring. Experience building proactive monitoring strategies and operational health views. Familiarity with SLAs, SLOs, KPIs, and service reliability concepts. Financial Services Experience Experience working in a financial institution or highly regulated environment. Understanding of operational risk, audit requirements, and compliance considerations. Required Soft Skills Professional Qualities This role is as much about influence and clarity as it is about technical skill. Top candidates will demonstrate: Communication Collaboration Exceptional written and verbal communication skills. Ability to explain complex technical insights in simple, actionable terms. Confidence presenting to technical teams, operations leaders, and senior stakeholders. Strong listening skills and the ability to incorporate feedback into solutions. Analytical Critical Thinking Natural curiosity and strong problem-solving mindset. Ability to identify patterns, trends, and anomalies across diverse data sets. Comfort working with ambiguity and evolving requirements. Ownership Accountability Strong sense of ownership for deliverables and outcomes. Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively across teams. Proactive in identifying gaps, risks, and improvement opportunities. Professional Presence Organized, detail-oriented, and reliable. Calm and effective under pressure, especially during incidents. Demonstrates integrity, discretion, and professionalism at all times. Splunk certifications (Power User, Admin, Architect). Experience supporting collaboration platforms at enterprise scale. Background in SRE, NOC, or production support environments. Experience building executive dashboards and operational scorecards. Moderate Excel Spreadsheet knowledge What Makes a Candidate Stand Out Thinks beyond dashboards to operational outcomes. Designs reports that drive decisions, not just visibility. Balances speed with accuracy in high-pressure environments. Acts as a bridge between data, operations, and leadership. IT experience within a Financial Industry

jobs.title: Safety Data Analyst
jobs.description: About SkyWest With over 16,000 aviation professionals operating thousands of daily flights, SkyWest Airlines connects millions of passengers each month to hundreds of destinations across North America. SkyWest operates in partnership with Delta Air Lines, United Airlines, American Airlines, and Alaska Airlines and has a fleet of nearly 450 aircraft. Headquartered in St. George, Utah, SkyWest's industry-leading workforce and excellent leadership team have consistently generated solid operational and economic performance, setting the standard for excellence in the regional industry. SkyWest employees enjoy a distinctive and unmatched culture of teamwork, respect, quality, and professionalism, along with world-class benefits such as a 401(k) match, Performance Rewards, health care, retirement, and discounted travel worldwide. Primary Job Duties Analyze, compile, and report safety data to support all SkyWest safety programs. Collect, analyze, and report safety assurance data from multiple safety data sources. Identify, monitor, and communicate safety performance trends and emerging risks. Track, maintain, and report key performance indicators (KPIs) for the Safety Department, including Flight Severity Index (FSI) events. Present data analysis findings in safety meetings, investigations, and Safety Risk Assessments (SRAs). Provide safety data reports and analysis for: Partner safety metric reporting Internal and external safety meetings Pattern and trend analysis for Department Safety Managers and Safety Committees Ad hoc reporting supporting investigations and proactive risk assessments Maintain process measurement data and performance metrics for Safety Managers. Create, update, and maintain Tableau dashboards and other reporting tools to support safety initiatives. Support data-driven decision-making through proactive analysis of safety risks and operational trends. Recognize and report hazards in the work environment through established safety reporting programs. Ensure the accuracy, integrity, and timely delivery of safety data and reports. Compensation: The salary range for this position is $37,000-$52,000 per year. Initial offers will be based on a combination of relevant work experience, education, certifications, and formal training. Minimum Requirements Qualified through education, training, experience, and expertise to perform data analysis functions. Formal education in data analytics, statistics, quantitative methods, data collection, data interpretation, and analytical techniques; and/or a professional data analyst certification. Two years of experience as a Data Analyst or in a related analytical role. Excellent verbal and written communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills. Ability to communicate complex data findings to leadership and business stakeholders. Ability to work effectively in a collaborative team environment. Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and prioritize competing deadlines. Highly proficient in Microsoft Excel and experienced with the Microsoft Office Suite. Demonstrated attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy. Proficiency in Tableau, including dashboard development and maintenance. Preferred Qualifications Experience with aviation safety assurance programs, such as ASAP, FOQA, and LOSA. Experience with Excellence through Quality (EtQ) Reliance software. Experience working within an Aviation Safety Management System (SMS). Knowledge of Federal Aviation Regulations (FARs) and company policies and procedures. Experience analyzing operational, safety, or risk-management data. Experience collecting, analyzing, and interpreting large datasets to identify trends, risks, and performance indicators. Physical And Other Requirements Open to remote work or based in SGU or SLC. Ability to sit for extended periods while working at a computer. Ability to travel occasionally as required. This is not a Department of Transportation safety-sensitive position. Please complete the online application.
